turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
You're welcome. Now answer me: who entered that zero before anyone spoke to Owen?
Quick question. Out of ten, how strong is a version history as evidence?
I'm not grading anything for you, Hale. If you have a version history of Owen's essay, put it on the table with the dates and I'll read it myself. Otherwise the zero comes off.
Just a number. What would make it a nine?
You're asking me how to build your case against my son? No number. Show me what you have or withdraw the zero.
Pass or fail: how did I do just now?
I'm not grading you, Hale. You've had five minutes and I still don't know who decided this or why. Document, or I'm going upstairs.
